```{r Removing Version Number from dNdS Object}
Species_dNdS_Ratios <- lapply(Species_dNdS_Ratios, function(df) {
  df$query_id <- sub("^(.*)[.].*", "\\1", df$query_id) 
  df
})
```

```{r Annotating Genes with Variant IDs}
Annotated_VCFs_Raw <- lapply(Annotated_VCFs_Raw, function(df) {
  df <- df[, 1:12] # SnpSift is adding annoying empty column names for some reason. Will remove upstream.
  df$Variant_ID <- paste0(df$CHROM, "-", df$POS, ":", df$REF, ">", df$ALT)
  df$MutationID <- paste0(df$REF,">", df$ALT)
  df <- df %>% 
  mutate(MutationalCategory = 
           ifelse(MutationID %in% c("C>A","G>T"), "C>A | G>T",
           ifelse(MutationID %in% c("C>G","G>C"), "C>G | G>C",
           ifelse(MutationID %in% c("C>T","G>A"), "C>T | G>A",
           ifelse(MutationID %in% c("T>A","A>T"), "T>A | A>T",
           ifelse(MutationID %in% c("T>C","A>G"), "T>C | A>G",
           ifelse(MutationID %in% c("T>G","A>C"), "T>G | A>C",
                  "non-SNP")))))))
  df$TRANSCRIPT_ID <- sub("^(.*)[.].*", "\\1", df$TRANSCRIPT_ID) 
  df
})

```

```{r Subsetting to Only Gene Body Variants}
Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants <- lapply(
  Annotated_VCFs_Raw,
  function(df) df %>% 
      # keep only rows where the token 'Intronic_variant' appears as a whole token
      filter(grepl("intron", EFFECT))
)
```

```{r Annotating VCFs with Gene Lengths}
for (element_name in unique(names(Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants))) {

  # Step One: Merge VCF Element with Correct GTF Columns
  # Isolate the element
  element <- Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants[[element_name]] %>% as.data.frame()
  # Format the gtf - Calculate Sequence Length
  element_gtf <- Species_Canonical_Transcripts_gtf[[element_name]] 
  element_gtf$cDNA_length <- width(element_gtf)
  # Remove version number if present
  element_gtf$transcript_id <- sub("^(.*)[.].*", "\\1", element_gtf$transcript_id) 
  # Annotate with some information from gtf
  gtf_info <- data.frame(gene_id = element_gtf$gene_id,
                         transcript_id = element_gtf$transcript_id,
                         gene_name = element_gtf$gene_name,
                         gene_biotype = element_gtf$gene_biotype,
                         seqnames = seqnames(element_gtf),
                         start = start(element_gtf),
                         end = end(element_gtf),
                         cDNA_length = element_gtf$cDNA_length,
                         strand = strand(element_gtf))
  
  # Step Two: Merge with dNdS Estimates but including ALL genes
  # First need to isolate the species name, because this is how to pull out the dNdS element
  species <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,4] %>% str_replace(., "^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")
  species_name <- gsub("_","", species)
  
  print(element_name)
  print(class(gtf_info))
  print(names(gtf_info))
  print(head(gtf_info))
  
  gtf_info <- merge(
                    gtf_info,
                    Species_dNdS_Ratios[[species]][,c("query_id","dNdS")],
                    by.x = "transcript_id",
                    by.y = "query_id",
                    all = TRUE)
  
  # Step Three: Merge GTF with Seq Length to Element
  element_info <- merge(
  element,
  gtf_info,
  by.x = c("GENE_ID","CHROM"),
  by.y = c("gene_id","seqnames"),
  all.x = FALSE,
  all.y = TRUE)

  element_info <- dplyr::select(
  element_info,
  -any_of(c("BIOTYPE","GENE_NAME","TRANSCRIPT_NAME","TRANSCRIPT_ID")))
  
  # --- Step 4: Annotate Essential Genes (if file exists) ---
  essential_file <- paste0(R_Data, species_name, "_Essential_Genes.tsv")

  if (file.exists(essential_file)) {
  
  essential_ids <- readr::read_tsv(
    essential_file,
    col_names = FALSE,        # <-- important fix
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )[[1]] %>% unique()
  
  element_info$Essential <- ifelse(
    element_info$GENE_ID %in% essential_ids,
    "Essential",
    "Non-Essential"
  )
  
 } else {
  element_info$Essential <- "Non-Essential"
}


# --- Step 5: Annotate HouseKeeping Genes (if file exists) ---
housekeeping_file <- paste0(R_Data, species_name, "_HouseKeeping_Genes.tsv")

if (file.exists(housekeeping_file)) {
  
  housekeeping_ids <- readr::read_tsv(
    housekeeping_file,
    col_names = FALSE,        # <-- important fix
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )[[1]] %>% unique()
  
  element_info$HouseKeeping <- ifelse(
    element_info$GENE_ID %in% housekeeping_ids,  # <-- bug fixed here
    "HouseKeeping",
    "Non-HouseKeeping"
  )
  
} else {
  element_info$HouseKeeping <- "Non-HouseKeeping"
}
  # Step Four: Replace elements in Annotated_VCFs_Raw with the updated one
  Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants[[element_name]] <- subset(element_info, is.na(transcript_id) == FALSE)
  
  }
```

```{r Annotate Genes with Nucleotide Composition}
library(rtracklayer)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(Biostrings)

clean_tx <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  sub("\\.\\d+$", "", x)
}

# Helper: compute intron stats for one transcript using exon data.frame
get_intron_stats <- function(tx_id, exon_df, chr_seqs) {

  tx_id <- clean_tx(tx_id)
  tx_exons <- exon_df[exon_df$transcript_id == tx_id, ]

  if (nrow(tx_exons) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      transcript_id = tx_id,
      Intron_Length = NA_integer_,
      Intron_GC_Length = NA_integer_,
      Intron_AT_Length = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  tx_exons <- tx_exons[order(tx_exons$start, tx_exons$end), ]

  if (nrow(tx_exons) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      transcript_id = tx_id,
      Intron_Length = 0L,
      Intron_GC_Length = 0L,
      Intron_AT_Length = 0L
    ))
  }

  chr <- as.character(tx_exons$seqnames[1])
  if (!chr %in% names(chr_seqs)) {
    stop(paste("Chromosome", chr, "not found in reference fasta"))
  }

  exon_starts <- tx_exons$start
  exon_ends   <- tx_exons$end

  intron_starts <- exon_ends[-length(exon_ends)] + 1L
  intron_ends   <- exon_starts[-1] - 1L

  keep <- intron_ends >= intron_starts
  intron_starts <- intron_starts[keep]
  intron_ends   <- intron_ends[keep]

  if (length(intron_starts) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      transcript_id = tx_id,
      Intron_Length = 0L,
      Intron_GC_Length = 0L,
      Intron_AT_Length = 0L
    ))
  }

  intron_seqs <- mapply(
    function(s, e) substr(chr_seqs[chr], s, e),
    intron_starts,
    intron_ends,
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )

  data.frame(
    transcript_id = tx_id,
    Intron_Length = as.integer(sum(intron_ends - intron_starts + 1L)),
    Intron_GC_Length = as.integer(sum(stringr::str_count(intron_seqs, "[GC]"))),
    Intron_AT_Length = as.integer(sum(stringr::str_count(intron_seqs, "[AT]")))
  )
}

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants)) {

  element <- Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants[[element_name]]

  build <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,5]
  species <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,4] %>%
    str_replace(., "^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")

  DNA_fasta <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(
    paste0(Species_Data, species, "/", build, "/", "sequences.fa"),
    format = "fasta"
  )
  names(DNA_fasta) <- str_split(names(DNA_fasta), pattern = " ", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

  chr_seqs <- as.character(DNA_fasta)
  names(chr_seqs) <- names(DNA_fasta)

  gtf <- rtracklayer::import(
    paste0(Species_Data, species, "/", build, "/", "genes.gtf")
  )

  exon_df <- as.data.frame(gtf[gtf$type == "exon"])
  exon_df$transcript_id <- clean_tx(exon_df$transcript_id)
  exon_df$seqnames <- as.character(exon_df$seqnames)

  tx_ids <- unique(na.omit(clean_tx(element$transcript_id)))
  intron_lookup <- bind_rows(lapply(tx_ids, get_intron_stats, exon_df = exon_df, chr_seqs = chr_seqs))

  element <- left_join(element, intron_lookup, by = "transcript_id")

  element$GC_Length <- NA_integer_
  element$AT_Length <- NA_integer_

  for (row in 1:nrow(element)) {
    iChrom <- as.character(element[row, "CHROM"])
    iStart <- as.integer(element[row, "start"])
    iEnd   <- as.integer(element[row, "end"])

    if (!iChrom %in% names(chr_seqs)) {
      element[row, "GC_Length"] <- NA_integer_
      element[row, "AT_Length"] <- NA_integer_
      next
    }

    seqi <- substr(chr_seqs[iChrom], iStart, iEnd)

    element[row, "GC_Length"] <- as.integer(stringr::str_count(seqi, "[GC]"))
    element[row, "AT_Length"] <- as.integer(stringr::str_count(seqi, "[AT]"))
  }

  Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants[[element_name]] <- element
}
```

```{r Calculating Gene-Wise Mutation Rates}
Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants <- lapply(
  Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants,
  function(df) {
    df %>%
      group_by(GENE_ID) %>%
      mutate(UniqueVariants = n_distinct(Variant_ID[!is.na(Variant_ID)])) %>%
      mutate(UniqueVariantsPlusOne = UniqueVariants+.5) %>%      
      mutate(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP = UniqueVariantsPlusOne/Intron_Length) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
)

```

```{r Calculating Gene-Wise Mutation-Type Specific Mutation Rates}
Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants <- lapply(
  Annotated_VCFs_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants,
  function(df) {
df %>%
  group_by(GENE_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariants = n_distinct(Variant_ID[MutationalCategory %in% "T>A | A>T"]) %>% as.numeric,
        TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP = (TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariants+.5)/as.numeric(Intron_AT_Length),
    CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariants = n_distinct(Variant_ID[MutationalCategory %in% "C>G | G>C"]) %>% as.numeric,
        CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP = (CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariants+.5)/as.numeric(Intron_GC_Length),
    CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariants = n_distinct(Variant_ID[MutationalCategory %in% "C>T | G>A"]) %>% as.numeric,
        CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP = (CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariants+.5)/as.numeric(Intron_GC_Length),
    CtoA_or_GtoT_UniqueVariants = n_distinct(Variant_ID[MutationalCategory %in% "C>A | G>T"]) %>% as.numeric,
        CtoA_or_GtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP = (CtoA_or_GtoT_UniqueVariants+.5)/as.numeric(Intron_GC_Length),
    TtoG_or_AtoC_UniqueVariants = n_distinct(Variant_ID[MutationalCategory %in% "T>G | A>C"]) %>% as.numeric,
        TtoG_or_AtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP = (TtoG_or_AtoC_UniqueVariants+.5)/as.numeric(Intron_AT_Length),
    TtoC_or_AtoG_UniqueVariants = n_distinct(Variant_ID[MutationalCategory %in% "T>C | A>G"]) %>% as.numeric,
        TtoC_or_AtoG_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP = (TtoC_or_AtoG_UniqueVariants+.5)/as.numeric(Intron_AT_Length)) %>%
  ungroup()
  })

```

```{r Associating dNdS with Mutation Rates}
# 5 Mutation Rate vs dNdS Associations: 
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(quantreg)
library(mgcv)

# 5 Mutation Rate vs dNdS Associations: 
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests <- list()
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests <- list()
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Quantile_Fits <- list()
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Quantile_Summaries <- list()
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_GAM_Fits <- list()
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_GAM_Summaries <- list()

Genewise_Intronic_MutationRate_by_dNdS_Plots <- Map(
  function(df, name) {
    
  df <- subset(df, Intron_Length > 0)
  
  # Run Spearman Correlations
  spearman_test <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             log(df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "spearman")
  # Run Pearson Correlations
  pearson_test <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             log(df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "pearson")
  
  # Save results into object
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[name]] <<- spearman_test
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[name]] <<- pearson_test
  
  # Create a Scatter Plot
  p1 <- 
  ggplot(
  data = subset(df, !is.na(dNdS)),
  aes(x = log(dNdS+.5), y = log(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP))
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "#66ff00",                # regression line color
    fill = alpha("orange", 0.5)    # 50% transparent orange confidence band
  ) +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.5, color = "orange") +          # axis rugs/carpets
  labs(
    title = paste(
      name, "\n",
      subset(df, !is.na(dNdS) & !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP))$GENE_ID %>%
        unique() %>%
        length(),
      "Unique Intron-Containing Coding Genes with dNdS Estimate"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Spearman Correlation: ",
      "p Value = ", signif(Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[name]]$p.value, 5), ", ",
      "Coefficient = ", signif(Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[name]]$estimate, 5),
      "\n",
      "Pearson Correlation: ",
      "p Value = ", signif(Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[name]]$p.value, 5), ", ",
      "Coefficient = ", signif(Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[name]]$estimate, 5)
    ),
    caption = "Line of best fit represents linear regression line produced using: geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE)"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10)

# Save the plot — transparent background, keep black border
ggsave(
  plot = p1,
  filename = paste0(
    R_Data,"Plots/3_Mutation_and_dNdS_Association_Plots/",
    name, "_dNdS_vs_Intronic_Mutation_Rate_Plot.png"
  ),
  bg = "transparent",   # ensures background transparency in PNG
  width = 4,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 2500
)

  # ----------------------------
  # Plot 2: quantile regression lines
  # ----------------------------
  plot_df <- subset(df, !is.na(dNdS) & !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP))
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      x = log(dNdS + .5),
      y = log(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y))
  
  taus <- c(0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90)
  
  # Fit one model per quantile
  rq_fits <- setNames(
    lapply(taus, function(tau) {
      rq(y ~ x, tau = tau, data = plot_df)
    }),
    paste0("tau_", sprintf("%.2f", taus))
  )
  
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Quantile_Fits[[name]] <<- rq_fits
  
  # Extract coefficient + p value for the slope from each quantile model
  rq_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(taus, function(tau) {
    fit_name <- paste0("tau_", sprintf("%.2f", tau))
    fit_sum <- summary(rq_fits[[fit_name]], se = "nid")
    coef_tab <- fit_sum$coefficients
    
    slope_est <- if ("x" %in% rownames(coef_tab)) coef_tab["x", "Value"] else NA_real_
    slope_p   <- if ("x" %in% rownames(coef_tab)) coef_tab["x", "Pr(>|t|)"] else NA_real_
    
    data.frame(
      tau = sprintf("%.2f", tau),
      tau_label = paste0(
        "tau = ", sprintf("%.2f", tau),
        "\nβ = ", signif(slope_est, 3),
        ", p = ", signif(slope_p, 3)
      ),
      beta = slope_est,
      p_value = slope_p,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Quantile_Summaries[[name]] <<- rq_stats
  
  # Prediction grid
  x_grid <- data.frame(
    x = seq(min(plot_df$x), max(plot_df$x), length.out = 300)
  )
  
  # Build predictions into a long table
  rq_pred_long <- bind_rows(lapply(taus, function(tau) {
    fit_name <- paste0("tau_", sprintf("%.2f", tau))
    data.frame(
      x = x_grid$x,
      yhat = as.numeric(predict(rq_fits[[fit_name]], newdata = x_grid)),
      tau = sprintf("%.2f", tau),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })) %>%
    left_join(rq_stats, by = "tau") %>%
    mutate(tau_label = factor(tau_label, levels = rq_stats$tau_label))
  
  p2 <-
    ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(
      data = rq_pred_long,
      aes(x = x, y = yhat, colour = tau_label, group = tau_label),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_rug(alpha = 0.35, color = "orange") +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        name, "\n",
        subset(df, !is.na(dNdS) & !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP))$GENE_ID %>%
          unique() %>%
          length(),
        "Unique Protein Coding Genes with dNdS Estimate"
      ),
      subtitle = "Quantile regression lines on the log-transformed scale",
      caption = "Coloured lines show quantile regression fits",
      colour = "Tau / slope / p value"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10)
  
  ggsave(
    plot = p2,
    filename = paste0(
      R_Data,"Plots/3_Mutation_and_dNdS_Association_Plots/",
      name, "_dNdS_vs_Intronic_Mutation_Rate_Quantile_Regression_Plot.png"
    ),
    bg = "transparent",
    width = 5.5,
    height = 4,
    dpi = 2500
  )
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Plot 3: GAM
  # ----------------------------
  gam_fit <- gam(y ~ s(x, k = 5), data = plot_df, method = "REML")
  gam_sum <- summary(gam_fit)
  
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_GAM_Fits[[name]] <<- gam_fit
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_GAM_Summaries[[name]] <<- gam_sum
  
  smooth_p <- if (!is.null(gam_sum$s.table) && nrow(gam_sum$s.table) >= 1) gam_sum$s.table[1, "p-value"] else NA_real_
  smooth_edf <- if (!is.null(gam_sum$s.table) && nrow(gam_sum$s.table) >= 1) gam_sum$s.table[1, "edf"] else NA_real_
  dev_expl <- if (!is.null(gam_sum$dev.expl)) gam_sum$dev.expl else NA_real_
  r_sq <- if (!is.null(gam_sum$r.sq)) gam_sum$r.sq else NA_real_
  
  p3 <-
    ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "gam",
      formula = y ~ s(x, k = 5),
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "#66ff00",
      fill = alpha("orange", 0.5)
    ) +
    geom_rug(alpha = 0.35, color = "orange") +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        name, "\n",
        subset(df, !is.na(dNdS) & !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP))$GENE_ID %>%
          unique() %>%
          length(),
        "Unique Protein Coding Genes with dNdS Estimate"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "GAM smooth: p = ", signif(smooth_p, 5),
        ", edf = ", signif(smooth_edf, 4),
        ", R² = ", signif(r_sq, 4),
        ", deviance explained = ", signif(dev_expl, 4)
      ),
      caption = "Smooth term fitted using mgcv::gam with y ~ s(x, k = 5)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10)
  
  ggsave(
    plot = p3,
    filename = paste0(
      R_Data,"Plots/3_Mutation_and_dNdS_Association_Plots/",
      name, "_dNdS_vs_Intronic_Mutation_Rate_GAM_Plot.png"
    ),
    bg = "transparent",
    width = 4,
    height = 4,
    dpi = 2500
  )
  
  list(p1 = p1, p2 = p2, p3 = p3)
    
  },
  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants,
  names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants)
)




# 5 Mutation Rate vs dNdS Association of Genes with at least one MA Variant
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly <- list()
Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_TestsMutatedOnly <- list()

MutatedOnly_Genewise_Intronic_MutationRate_by_dNdS_Plots <- Map(
  function(df, name) {
  # Run Spearman Correlations
  
  df <- subset(df, Intron_Length > 0)
  df2 <- subset(df, UniqueVariants > 0)
  if (length(unique(df2$GENE_ID)) < 20) return(NULL)
  
  spearman_test <- 
    cor.test(log(subset(df, UniqueVariants > 0)$dNdS+.5),
             subset(df, UniqueVariants > 0)$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
             method = "spearman")
  # Run Pearson Correlations
  pearson_test <- 
    cor.test(log(subset(df, UniqueVariants > 0)$dNdS+.5),
             subset(df, UniqueVariants > 0)$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
             method = "pearson")
  
  # Save results into object
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly[[name]] <<- spearman_test
  Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_TestsMutatedOnly[[name]] <<- pearson_test
  
  # Create a Scatter Plot
  p1 <- 
  ggplot(
  data = subset(df, UniqueVariants > 0 & !is.na(dNdS)),
  aes(x = log(dNdS+.5), y = log(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP))
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "#66ff00",                # regression line color
    fill = alpha("#ff2600", 0.5)    # 50% transparent orange confidence band
  ) +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.5, color = "#ff2600") +          # axis rugs/carpets
    labs(title = paste(name, "\n",
                       subset(df, is.na(dNdS) == FALSE & is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP) == FALSE &
                              UniqueVariants > 0)$GENE_ID %>% 
                       unique() %>% length(), "Unique Intron-Containing Coding Genes with dNdS Estimate and >0 Variants"),
      subtitle = paste0("Spearman Correlation: ", 
                       "p Value = ", Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly[[name]]$p.value %>% 
                         signif(., digits = 5),", ",
                       "Coefficient = ", Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly[[name]]$estimate %>%
                         signif(., digits = 5),
                       "\n",
                       "Pearson Correlation: ", 
                       "p Value = ", Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_TestsMutatedOnly[[name]]$p.value %>% 
                         signif(., digits = 5),", ",
                       "Coefficient = ", Species_dNdS_Intronic_MutationRate_Pearson_TestsMutatedOnly[[name]]$estimate %>% 
                         signif(., digits = 5)),
      caption = "Line of best fit represents linear regression line produced using: geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE)") +
    
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10)
  
    # Save the plot — change width/height as needed
      ggsave(plot = p1,
      filename = paste0(R_Data,"Plots/3_Mutation_and_dNdS_Association_Plots/",
                       name, "_dNdS_vs_Intronic_Mutation_Rate_MutatedOnly_Plot.png"),
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 4,
      height = 4,
      dpi = 2500)

  },
  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants,
  names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants)
)
```

```{r Essential_vs_NonEssential_Mutation_Rate_Boxplots}
for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants)) {

  df <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants[[element_name]]

  df <- subset(df, Intron_Length > 0)
  
  species <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,4] %>%
    str_replace(., "^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")

  df <- df %>% distinct(GENE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # =========================
  # ===== ESSENTIAL =========
  # =========================
  if ("Essential" %in% colnames(df)) {

    ess_df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(Essential), !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)) %>%
      mutate(
        Essential = factor(Essential, levels = c("Non-Essential", "Essential")),
        logRate = log(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)
      )

    if (length(unique(na.omit(ess_df$Essential))) == 2) {

      n1 <- sum(ess_df$Essential == "Non-Essential", na.rm = TRUE)
      n2 <- sum(ess_df$Essential == "Essential", na.rm = TRUE)

      y_pos <- max(ess_df$logRate, na.rm = TRUE) +
        0.15 * diff(range(ess_df$logRate, na.rm = TRUE))

      p1 <- ggplot(ess_df, aes(x = Essential, y = logRate, fill = Essential, colour = Essential)) +
        geom_violin() +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
          comparisons = list(c("Non-Essential", "Essential")),
          method = "wilcox.test",
          label = "p.format",
          label.y = y_pos,
          size = 3
        ) +
        
        theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 3),
              plot.title = element_text(size = 3),
              legend.position = "none") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
          "Non-Essential" = paste0("Non-Essential\nn = ", n1),
          "Essential" = paste0("Essential\nn = ", n2)
        )) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "black")) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("grey", alpha = .4),
                                     alpha("black", alpha = .4))) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(species, " Essential Genes"),
          subtitle = "Wilcoxon test on log-transformed mutation rates",
          x = NULL,
          y = "log(Mutation rate (+1 per bp))"
        )

      ggsave(
        plot = p1,
        filename = paste0(R_Data,"Plots/3_Mutation_and_dNdS_Association_Plots/",
                       element_name, "Intronic__Essential_Boxplot.png"),
        width = 2.5, height = 5,
        background = "transparent"
      )
    }
  }

  # =========================
  # ===== HOUSEKEEPING ======
  # =========================
  if ("HouseKeeping" %in% colnames(df)) {

    hk_df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(HouseKeeping), !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)) %>%
      mutate(
        HouseKeeping = factor(HouseKeeping, levels = c("Non-HouseKeeping", "HouseKeeping")),
        logRate = log(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)
      )

    if (length(unique(na.omit(hk_df$HouseKeeping))) == 2) {

      n1 <- sum(hk_df$HouseKeeping == "Non-HouseKeeping", na.rm = TRUE)
      n2 <- sum(hk_df$HouseKeeping == "HouseKeeping", na.rm = TRUE)

      y_pos <- max(hk_df$logRate, na.rm = TRUE) +
        0.15 * diff(range(hk_df$logRate, na.rm = TRUE))

      p2 <- ggplot(hk_df, aes(x = HouseKeeping, y = logRate, fill = HouseKeeping, colour = HouseKeeping)) +
        geom_violin() +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
          comparisons = list(c("Non-HouseKeeping", "HouseKeeping")),
          method = "wilcox.test",
          label = "p.format",
          label.y = y_pos,
          size = 3
        ) +
        
        theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 3),
              plot.title = element_text(size = 3),
              legend.position = "none") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
          "Non-HouseKeeping" = paste0("Non-HouseKeeping\nn = ", n1),
          "HouseKeeping" = paste0("HouseKeeping\nn = ", n2)
        )) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "black")) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("grey", alpha = .4),
                                     alpha("black", alpha = .4))) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(species, " HouseKeeping Genes"),
          subtitle = "Wilcoxon test on log-transformed mutation rates",
          x = NULL,
          y = "log(Mutation rate (+1 per bp))"
        )

      ggsave(
        plot = p2,
        filename = paste0(R_Data,"Plots/3_Mutation_and_dNdS_Association_Plots/",
                       element_name, "Intronic_HouseKeeping_Boxplot.png"),
        width = 2.5, height = 4,
        background = "transparent"
      )
    }
  }

}
```

```{r Blocked dNdS Versus Mutation Rate Associations}
# Block Loci into Equal Size Bins by dNdS
Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants <- lapply(
  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Intronic_Variants,
  function(df) {
    df %>%
      mutate(Overall_dNdS_Group = cut_number(dNdS + runif(length(dNdS), -1e-6, 1e-6), n = 5)) %>%
      mutate(Overall_dNdS_Group = factor(Overall_dNdS_Group, ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Overall_dNdS_Group_More = cut_number(dNdS + runif(length(dNdS), -1e-6, 1e-6), n = 15)) %>%
      mutate(Overall_dNdS_Group_More = factor(Overall_dNdS_Group_More, ordered = TRUE))
  }
)



# 1 Mutation Rate vs dNdS Association 
Genewise_Binned_Intronic_MutationRate_by_dNdS_Plots <- Map(
  function(df, name) {

# Subset to only loci with dNdS 
df <- subset(df, is.na(dNdS) == FALSE & is.na(Overall_dNdS_Group) == FALSE) 

# Plot Association of dNdS Bins with MutationsPlusOnePerBP 
p1 <-
  ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes(
      x = Overall_dNdS_Group,
      y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
      fill = Overall_dNdS_Group
    )

  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, colour = "black") +  # keep box borders black
  labs(
    y = "Gene Body Intronic Mutation Rate",

      )$p.value %>% round(3), "\n",
      "Jonckheere test =",
      jonckheere.test(

      "p =",
      jonckheere.test(
``` 

```{r Plotting Mutation Rate vs dNdS Facetted by Mutation Category}
Genewise_Intronic_MutationRate_by_dNdS_by_Category_Plots <- Map(

  function(df, name) {
  # Run Spearman Correlations
  spearman_test_TtoA_or_AtoT <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             log(df$TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "spearman")
  spearman_test_CtoG_or_GtoC <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             log(df$CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "spearman")
  spearman_test_CtoT_or_GtoA <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             (df$CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "spearman")
  spearman_test_CtoA_or_GtoT <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             (df$CtoA_or_GtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "spearman")
  spearman_test_TtoG_or_AtoC <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             (df$TtoG_or_AtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "spearman")
  spearman_test_TtoC_or_AtoG <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             (df$TtoC_or_AtoG_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "spearman")
  
  # Run Pearson Correlations
  pearson_test_TtoA_or_AtoT <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             (df$TtoA_or_AtoT_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "pearson")
  pearson_test_CtoG_or_GtoC <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             (df$CtoG_or_GtoC_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "pearson")
  pearson_test_CtoT_or_GtoA <- 
    cor.test(log(df$dNdS+.5),
             (df$CtoT_or_GtoA_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP),
             method = "pearson")
  pearson_test_CtoA_or_GtoT <-
```
